en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a central photograph bordered by decorative scrollwork. The scene shows a waterfront street with a stone promenade, buildings rising closely along the left, pedestrians walking, and a man leaning on a railing beside a tall lamppost. The sea is on the right. There is a green Greek postage stamp with a postmark in the upper right of the photo area. French and Greek printed text as well as handwritten Greek inscriptions appear around the image.
